headline: SITCON 2 (SEVERE): Vanderbilt ransomware attack escalates; Barracuda ESG and OpenSSH SSHole exploitation continue

bullets.text: Changed: The Register reports a ransomware threat blared from Vanderbilt University computers during the cyberattack; BleepingComputer earlier reported a BYOD ransomware attack with data theft claimed. Now 4 outlets. No new critical reports this sweep; SITCON holds at 2 (SEVERE).

Changed: DataBreaches.net reports a data breach at The Children's Foundation. Separately, NEPSE's cybersecurity report after its ransomware attack is criticized as offering only superficial fixes. Seminole County clerk's office remains closed after a cyberattack, due back Monday.

Still active: attackers are exploiting critical Barracuda Email Security Gateway flaws to gain root access; the brief names no CVEs or fixed releases. SAP also patched four CVSS 10.0 flaws, two enabling remote code execution, with no exploitation reported.

SSHole (OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158) is still being used to breach Linux systems; the story spans 6 outlets. It sits in CISA KEV with GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218, all added 11-09 and due 11-12.
N-able's hosted N-central remains offline in 3 outlets' reporting, after a researcher published more than 30 zero-days (33 by one count) with proof-of-concept exploits. No fixes are named yet.

Google patched the eighth exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026 (CVE-2026-125350). France blames Iran for sabotage of refrigeration controllers at about 700 retail sites (4 outlets). 300 malicious packages were listed in 7 days, mostly npm; the week ran 0.87x the 90-day average.

actions: Barracuda ESG: check Barracuda's advisory, apply available fixes, restrict management access and review appliances for signs of root compromise.
Patch OpenSSH for CVE-2026-123158 on every internet-facing host; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for unexpected logins.
Patch or isolate GPUStack (CVE-2026-102895), FreeSwitch (CVE-2026-116779) and IBM Aspera Faspex (CVE-2026-123218) before the 11-12 KEV deadline.
Apply SAP's November security patches, starting with the four CVSS 10.0 flaws on internet-reachable systems.
Update Chrome on all endpoints (fixes CVE-2026-125350) and restart browsers; VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 is due in KEV on 11-11.
N-central users: plan for the hosted outage, limit network exposure of N-central servers and agents, and watch N-able for fixes.
